name: artifacts-beam
description: Publish HTML to Artifacts Beam, share revocable review links, collect comments and annotations, and publish versioned updates from your coding agent. Supports workspace selection and browser/device sign-in. Share-link viewing can be anonymous; commenting requires sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Publish local HTML in your chosen Artifacts Beam workspace, create revocable share links, and bring comments and annotations back into your coding agent. Viewing share links can be anonymous; commenting requires sign-in. Update an explicit artifact, compare versions, or apply feedback against a captured published revision without silently appending stale changes. Workspace access, sharing policies, quotas, and retention still apply. Requires desktop execution with Node.js 18+.
capabilities: Select the active workspace and publish local HTML
Create revocable, optionally version-pinned share links
Read review packets, comments, and annotations
Publish feedback-driven updates with a stale-base precondition
Reply to comments and resolve explicitly approved threads
Compare versions and manage visibility and tags
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $artifacts-beam to publish this HTML and give me a link my team can comment on.
